collection.name: AOP-Wiki SPARQL examples
collection.description: Example SPARQL queries for the AOP-Wiki RDF SPARQL endpoint, shown in the query editor at https://aopwiki.rdf.bigcat-bioinformatics.org/.

examples.description: Returns the total number of RDF triples in the AOP-Wiki dataset.
examples.query:
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT *) AS ?Triples)
WHERE { ?s ?p ?o }

examples.label: Find AOPs applicable to mammals
examples.description: Returns every AOP that has taxonomic applicability to a mammalian taxon (Mammalia, NCBI taxon 40674) — species, sub-species and higher mammalian groups. The mammalian taxon set was resolved once from the UniProt taxonomy (rdfs:subClassOf* taxon:40674) over the taxa actually used in AOP-Wiki, then inlined as VALUES so this query is self-contained and always resolves — no live federated call. To refresh the list (e.g. after new species are curated), re-run the UniProt expansion in H. Federated/aops-for-taxon.rq. Currently matches 175 AOPs across 50 mammalian taxa.
examples.query:
PREFIX aopo: <http://aopkb.org/aop_ontology#>
PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
PREFIX ncbitaxon: <http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/NCBITAXON/>

SELECT ?aop ?aopTitle
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?species; separator=" | ") AS ?mammalianSpecies)
WHERE {
  VALUES ?taxon {
    ncbitaxon:9258   ncbitaxon:9261   ncbitaxon:9395   ncbitaxon:9483   ncbitaxon:9534   ncbitaxon:9541
    ncbitaxon:9544   ncbitaxon:9555   ncbitaxon:9595   ncbitaxon:9606   ncbitaxon:9615   ncbitaxon:9627
    ncbitaxon:9651   ncbitaxon:9666   ncbitaxon:9669   ncbitaxon:9678   ncbitaxon:9685   ncbitaxon:9689
    ncbitaxon:9696   ncbitaxon:9823   ncbitaxon:9833   ncbitaxon:9872   ncbitaxon:9874   ncbitaxon:9913
    ncbitaxon:9986   ncbitaxon:10036  ncbitaxon:10090  ncbitaxon:10095  ncbitaxon:10116  ncbitaxon:10117
    ncbitaxon:10118  ncbitaxon:10141  ncbitaxon:10185  ncbitaxon:29064  ncbitaxon:34880  ncbitaxon:37347
    ncbitaxon:39108  ncbitaxon:39442  ncbitaxon:58060  ncbitaxon:61383  ncbitaxon:61388  ncbitaxon:69158
    ncbitaxon:70699  ncbitaxon:94180  ncbitaxon:230844 ncbitaxon:310402 ncbitaxon:419130 ncbitaxon:435435
    ncbitaxon:447135 ncbitaxon:452597
  }
  ?aop a aopo:AdverseOutcomePathway ;
       dc:title ?aopTitle ;
       ncbitaxon:131567 ?taxon .
  ?taxon a ncbitaxon:131567 ;
         dc:title ?species .
}
GROUP BY ?aop ?aopTitle
ORDER BY ?aopTitle

examples.label: Get AO for a specific MIE

examples.label: List methods for AOPs
examples.description: Returns Key Events with their applicable species and measurement methods for a specific AOP.
examples.query:
PREFIX aopo: <http://aopkb.org/aop_ontology#>
PREFIX dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/>
PREFIX mmo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MMO_>
PREFIX ncbitaxon: <http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/NCBITAXON/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?aop ?ke
  (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?speciesname; separator=" | ") AS ?speciesnames)
  ?method
WHERE {
  VALUES ?aop { <https://identifiers.org/aop/12> }
  ?aop aopo:has_key_event ?ke .
  ?ke ncbitaxon:131567 ?taxon .
  ?taxon a ncbitaxon:131567 ;
    dc:title ?speciesname .
  OPTIONAL { ?ke mmo:0000000 ?method . }
}
GROUP BY ?aop ?ke ?method
ORDER BY ASC(?aop)

examples.label: List stressors and their MIEs
examples.description: Returns all stressors and the Molecular Initiating Events they are linked to through AOPs.

examples.label: Gene detection method summary (regex vs BERN2 NER)
examples.description: Counts gene-Key Event associations by detection method. edam:data_1025 holds the union of all detected genes; :geneDetectedByRegex and :geneDetectedByNER record provenance. Shows total NER associations, how many were also found by the regex mapper, and how many were found only by NER.
examples.query:
PREFIX p: <https://aopwiki.rdf.bigcat-bioinformatics.org/>

SELECT
  (COUNT(*) AS ?ner_total)
  (SUM(IF(EXISTS { ?ke p:geneDetectedByRegex ?gene }, 1, 0)) AS ?ner_and_regex)
  (SUM(IF(EXISTS { ?ke p:geneDetectedByRegex ?gene }, 0, 1)) AS ?ner_only)
WHERE {
  ?ke p:geneDetectedByNER ?gene .
}

examples.label: List annotated genes for AOPs
examples.description: Returns all genes annotated in Key Events across AOPs, including the protein identifiers and object names.

examples.label: List identifier-mapped genes for AOPs
examples.description: Returns all non-annotated genes from Key Events of AOPs, with HGNC symbols and NCBI gene identifiers. Genes are text-mined from Key Event descriptions by two detectors: an HGNC dictionary matcher (regex) and BERN2 named-entity recognition (NER). The detectedBy column says which found each gene, and the Detection method filter restricts the list, e.g. to genes confirmed by both.

examples.label: Genes found only by BERN2 NER (not by regex)
examples.description: Lists gene-Key Event associations detected by the BERN2 NER+EL mapper that the legacy regex mapper did not find. These are the net-new genes contributed by named-entity recognition over Key Event descriptions.
